note: The 12.5% H1 progress against a held 3,200m FY plan is a classic visible-miss computable from the July 短信 (LESSONS rule 1 pushes p_up toward 50), and only the revision decision itself is new; the company's own 差異 notice points the other way, and the whole forecast line has historically moved this illiquid name about 1% either way, with the July 2026 miss-and-hold actually buying +1.25%.

The reported half was pre-released to the 100m yen on 2026-10-19 and the FY was held in the same document, so the period findings go to zero (core 3b/4) and the only unpriced item is the small chance the print raises the FY; the 10-20 pop was fully given back and 信用倍率 24.86x is already the baseline lean, so this is close to the pre-released non-result LESSONS open question 3 describes.

Item 0 is the best-documented unpriced thing in the pack: Honda's August Japan output -32.3% with the quake attribution published 09-29/10-19 while the IFIS FY ordinary consensus sat unchanged at 62,350 for four weeks, into a name that sold a 6% Q1 beat -3.78% in July; the FX-raise room and the 25-30% buyback chance are real positive tails that keep the net small rather than reversing it.

Direct competitor Miraial's own disclosure (molding sales +29.7%, guide implying ~+65% for Aug-Oct, 'completely changed') lands on the 52%-of-sales precision-molding core while the stale IFIS H1 bar of 7,700m needs only ~3,550m against a weak 3,290m base, and the stock sits back at its post-Q1 sell-off level with the margin long overhang cleared and shorts quadrupled; this is also by far the widest-moving name here (median 4.21%, prints of +14.2/+8.7/-8.9), so abs_move is set well above the proxy, and the lean is capped at 60 because this name sold its last two beats.

Almost everything here is priced: the raise only meets a consensus already 2.7% above plan and the JEITA PC comp is public, leaving the unannounced buyback as the one board decision the market cannot see (the ¥30bn programme ended in May, ¥140.6bn of cash, and the equivalent Q3 2025 print with a ¥10bn buyback paid +7.92%); the +13.4% run-in at an all-time high is a near-restatement of the free control and LESSONS open question 4 says not to size a run-in as a large short, so it is kept small and the name nets near zero.
